literal_meaning: জব্দকৃত বা পরাজিত অবস্থা (প্রতিযোগিতা বা যুদ্ধে পতন)
figurative_meaning_en: Subdued, weakened, under control; inferior in strength
example_sentences_in_bangla: জ্বরে সে একেবারে কাবু হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is completely knocked out by the fever.
It's not easy to subdue me.
note: Idiom borrowed from Persian/Urdu, commonly used in colloquial Bengali to denote overpowering or debilitation.
